title: TRICARE Select Participating and Nonparticipating Providers and Balance Billing
content:
**Standing rule.** A participating provider under **TRICARE Select** (network, or non-network accepting assignment on the claim) is paid directly and may bill the beneficiary only the deductible and cost share. A nonparticipating provider is not paid by TRICARE: the TRICARE payment goes to the beneficiary, who pays the provider, and the provider may bill the beneficiary up to the tier's balance-billing limit above the allowed amount. The amount billed above the allowed amount is not a cost share, is never recorded as beneficiary liability and never counts toward the deductible or catastrophic cap.

## Maximum a nonparticipating provider may bill

The allowed amount multiplied by one hundred plus the balance-billing limit percentage, divided by one hundred, rounded to the cent. With the 15 percent limit of every Select tier, a hypothetical allowed amount of 250.00 gives a maximum of 287.50.

## Who is paid and what may be billed

| Provider | TRICARE payment goes to | Provider may bill the beneficiary |
|---|---|---|
| network | the provider | the deductible and cost share only |
| non-network, accepting assignment on the claim (participating) | the provider | the deductible and cost share only |
| non-network, not accepting assignment (nonparticipating) | the beneficiary | up to the maximum above |

In the hypothetical case above, the 37.50 a nonparticipating provider may bill beyond the 250.00 allowed amount is not recorded as beneficiary liability and adds nothing to the deductible or the catastrophic total.
